title: Disagreement-Guided Weak-to-Strong Routing
title_zh: 分歧引导的弱模型到强模型路由

paragraphs.en: Small language models are increasingly deployed on edge devices and robotic systems to meet cost and latency constraints, yet their limited capabilities can make reliable deployment challenging. Stronger models can provide assistance when needed, but deciding when to route a weak-model response to a stronger model often relies on signals of response correctness. In open-ended and agentic tasks, however, obtaining such signals can require costly ground-truth supervision that is difficult to obtain at scale. We revisit the foundations of weak-to-strong routing and ask whether routing decisions can instead be guided by signals that do not require ground-truth supervision. We first characterize the optimal weak-to-strong routing policy, while allowing for multiple weak-model responses generated through local inference. Building on this characterization, we derive a principled approximation to the optimal routing based on model-to-model comparison. In particular, we introduce a notion of model disagreement that can be measured directly from model-generated responses, without ground-truth supervision. Importantly, the approximation becomes increasingly accurate as the strong model becomes a better proxy for the ground-truth distribution. Across agentic and single-turn tasks, our approach effectively navigates the trade-off between routing cost and response accuracy without ground-truth supervision. Moreover, even when ground-truth correctness signals are available for training, disagreement-based routing can outperform methods trained directly to predict correctness.

paragraphs.en: Small language models offer a practical path to deploying AI agents on edge devices, robots, and other systems constrained by cost, latency, connectivity, or privacy. Yet their limited capabilities make it difficult to rely on them across the full range of tasks they may encounter [ 30 , 4 ] . This has motivated growing interest in systems that primarily rely on a weak LLM, but occasionally route difficult instances to a stronger model when additional capability is needed [ 15 , 51 , 5 ] .

paragraphs.en: The possibility of such routing changes how we should think about inference with weak LLMs. Rather than simply generating a response and returning it, inference now involves three decisions: whether to accept the current response, spend additional local computation on further reasoning or sampling, or seek assistance from a stronger model at substantially higher cost. These choices introduce a new trade-off: Stopping local inference too early miss improvements achievable through inexpensive additional computation; persisting locally for too long waste time and resources when stronger assistance is ultimately needed; and routing too readily undermines the cost and latency advantages of the weak model.
paragraphs.zh: 这种路由的可能性改变了我们思考弱 LLM 推理的方式。 如今，推理不再仅仅是生成一个响应并返回它，而是涉及三个决策：是否接受当前响应、在进一步推理或采样上投入额外的本地计算资源，还是以高得多的成本寻求更强模型的帮助。 这些选择引入了一个新的权衡：过早停止本地推理会错过通过低成本额外计算可能实现的改进；本地推理持续太久则会在最终需要更强模型帮助时浪费时间和资源；而过于轻易地转向路由则会削弱弱模型在成本和延迟方面的优势。

paragraphs.en: A natural way to navigate this trade-off is to assess response correctness through learned confidence scores, verifiers, or reward models [ 27 , 45 ] . In practical agentic applications, however, correctness is often difficult to evaluate. For a robotic agent, assessing a proposed next action may require knowledge of the physical environment and consequences that become apparent after execution. For a computer-use agent, whether an action is appropriate may depend on the state of an external application, user preferences, or the downstream effects of modifying a file or sending a message. More broadly, in long-horizon agentic workflows, a locally plausible action may undermine the eventual outcome, violate a user constraint, or introduce an error that becomes apparent several steps later [ 42 , 11 , 32 ] . Obtaining correctness labels in such settings may require subjective or expert judgment, interaction with the environment, or evaluation of entire trajectories. Such supervision is costly and does not readily scale across tasks and deployment conditions. These challenges motivate our central question:
paragraphs.zh: 一种自然的方法是通过已学习的置信度分数、验证器或奖励模型来评估响应的正确性，从而在这一权衡中做出决策 [ 27 , 45 ] 。 然而，在实际的智能体应用中，正确性往往难以评估。 对于机器人智能体而言，评估拟议的下一步动作可能需要了解物理环境以及执行后显现的后果。 对于计算机使用智能体而言，某个动作是否恰当可能取决于外部应用程序的状态、用户偏好，或者修改文件或发送消息所带来的后续影响。 更广泛地说，在长期智能体工作流程中，一个局部看似合理的动作可能会破坏最终结果、违反用户约束，或引入若干步之后才显现的错误 [ 42 , 11 , 32 ] 。 在此类设置中获得正确性标签可能需要主观判断或专家判断、与环境互动，或对完整轨迹进行评估。 此类监督成本高昂，且难以在不同任务和部署条件下轻松扩展。 这些挑战促使我们提出核心问题：

In Section 4 , we derive a novel, ground-truth-free approximation to the optimal routing signal based on two disagreement signals: how much the weak and strong models disagree, and how much the strong model disagrees with itself. Importantly, (i) the approximation gap shrinks as the strong model becomes more accurate, and (ii) both signals can be efficiently learned from scalable model-generated data, without ground-truth supervision .
paragraphs.zh: 通过模型分歧进行路由。 在第 4 节中，我们基于两种分歧信号推导出一种无需真实标签的最优路由信号的新近似方法：弱模型与强模型之间的分歧程度，以及强模型与其自身之间的分歧程度。 重要的是，(i) 随着强模型准确性的提高，近似差距会缩小；(ii) 这两种信号都可以从可扩展的模型生成数据中高效学习，而无需真实标签的监督。

paragraphs.en: The fundamental problem of knowing when a model should abstain or seek help has been extensively studied under the umbrella of learning-to-defer and selective prediction [ 33 , 19 ] . With the advent of large language models, this challenge translates into determining when a weak model should autonomously escalate to a stronger one. In parallel to frameworks that study deferral for verification [ 22 ] , our focus is on routing model generations. Many current cascade methods rely on ground-truth correctness labels to train quality scorers, process verifiers, or token-level confidence predictors [ 5 , 15 , 1 , 6 , 38 ] . In our experiments, we represent this paradigm using a ground-truth supervised baseline highlighting that our proposed framework fundamentally eliminates the need for such expensive, task-specific supervision.
paragraphs.zh: 关于模型何时应放弃回答或寻求帮助这一根本问题，在“延迟学习”和“选择性预测”的研究框架下得到了广泛探讨 [ 33 , 19 ] 。 随着大型语言模型的出现，这一挑战转化为如何判断一个较弱的模型何时应自主升级至更强的模型。 与研究验证性延迟的框架 [ 22 ] 并行，我们的重点是路由模型生成的结果。 许多当前的级联方法依赖真实标签来训练质量评分器、处理验证器或词元级别的置信度预测器 [ 5 , 15 , 1 , 6 , 38 ] 。 在我们的实验中，我们通过一个基于真实标签的监督基线模型来呈现这一范式，以此突出我们提出的框架从根本上消除了对这类昂贵且任务特定的监督的需求。

paragraphs.en: Label-free routing signals . To avoid human annotations, recent work extracts reliability signals directly from a single unlabeled generation using internal uncertainty metrics or hidden-state probes [ 15 , 24 , 10 ] . A prevalent alternative assesses reliability by generating multiple responses to measure internal agreement or semantic overlap [ 46 , 51 , 25 , 12 ] . These two paradigms motivate our label-free baselines in both settings to demonstrate that our single-pass, disagreement-trained probe yields a better routing signal than standard internal uncertainty metrics.
paragraphs.zh: 无标签的路由信号。 为避免依赖人工标注，近期研究直接从单个无标签生成结果中提取可靠性信号，方法包括使用内部不确定性指标或隐藏状态探针 [ 15 , 24 , 10 ] 。 一种常见的替代方案是通过生成多个响应来评估可靠性，以衡量模型内部的共识程度或语义重叠度 [ 46 , 51 , 25 , 12 ] 。 这两种范式启发我们在两种场景下设计了无标签的基线方法，以证明我们基于单次通过和分歧训练的探针能够产生比标准内部不确定性指标更优的路由信号。

paragraphs.en: In sequential environments, determining when to escalate an action to a stronger model is typically guided by process-level verifiers and trajectory-level rewards [ 20 , 17 , 41 ] , or frameworks for cost-aware decision support policies [ 21 ] . Because these approaches rely on explicit step-level correctness labels or complex episode-success evaluations, they are difficult to scale in open-ended domains. We contrast these paradigms with our agentic experiments, demonstrating that our framework can route actions autonomously at each step by predicting offline action disagreement, entirely bypassing the need for process verifiers or trajectory rewards.
paragraphs.zh: 在序列环境中，决定何时将某个动作升级到更强模型的过程，通常由流程级验证器和轨迹级奖励 [20, 17, 41]，或用于成本感知决策支持策略的框架 [21] 来引导。 由于这些方法依赖于显式的步骤级正确性标签或对整个回合成功与否的复杂评估，因此它们在开放领域的扩展应用十分困难。 我们将这些范式与我们的智能体实验进行了对比，结果表明，我们的框架可以通过预测离线动作分歧，在每个步骤中自主地路由动作，从而完全无需流程验证器或轨迹奖励。

paragraphs.en: In this section, we study the problem of weak-to-strong routing jointly with the allocation of local inference computation. 2 2 2 For simplicity, we model local test-time computation through repeated weak-model sampling (e.g., best-of- n n ), although more general forms of test-time inference are possible. We first study this problem at the population level, assuming access to the underlying probabilistic quantities, which allows us to characterize the optimal solution and identify the fundamental principles governing sampling, selection, and routing. In the next sections, we use these principles to develop practical methods that do not require access to such population quantities.
paragraphs.zh: 在本节中，我们研究弱模型到强模型的路由问题，并将其与局部推理计算的分配相结合。为简化起见，我们通过重复使用弱模型进行采样（例如，选择 n 次采样中的最佳结果）来模拟局部测试时的计算，尽管测试时推理也可以采用更通用的形式。 我们首先在总体层面上研究这个问题，假设可以获取底层的概率量，这使我们能够描述最优解，并确定指导采样、选择和路由的基本原理。 在接下来的几节中，我们将利用这些原理来开发实用的方法，而这些方法无需获取上述总体层面的概率量。

paragraphs.en: In multi-step environments, an agent completes a goal through a sequence of actions. Let H t = ( p , y 1 , o 1 , … , y t − 1 , o t − 1 ) H_{t}=(p,y^{1},o^{1},\dots,y^{t-1},o^{t-1}) denote the trajectory history at step t t , comprising the prompt p p , past actions y i y_{i} , and observations o i o_{i} . Rather than escalating entire trajectories, we formulate routing at the action level : given H t H_{t} , the router decides whether to execute the weak model’s action locally ( y w t y^{t}_{w} ) or defer that specific step to the strong model ( y s t y^{t}_{s} ). Defining step-level correctness in sequential environments is fundamentally difficult. Because tasks admit multiple valid paths, and expert evaluation is costly to scale [ 32 ] . Furthermore, locally plausible actions may cause delayed downstream failures, making long-horizon credit assignment ambiguous [ 11 ] . Consequently, correctness-supervised routers and automated LLM judges remain notoriously unreliable in agentic domains [ 42 , 54 ] .

paragraphs.en: Figure 2 shows both disagreement-based signals consistently outperform the best label-free baseline. Crucially, contrasting the two environments reveals how teacher capability dictates the value of the self-disagreement correction. In WebShop , where the strong model is highly capable, corrected disagreement significantly outperforms raw weak–strong disagreement. This reinforces our population-level finding: under a stronger teacher, the self-disagreement penalty prevents wasteful queries and the approximation approaches optimal routing. Conversely, in BFCL , the strong model itself struggles; here, the self-disagreement correction provides negligible benefit, rendering the gap between the two scores statistically insignificant. Beyond performance gains, the results highlight a practical advantage for agentic workflows. Because step-level correctness is inherently vague, determining exactly when an action requires escalation remains a persistent challenge. Relying instead on observable cross-model disagreement provides practitioners with a reliable, objective signal to safely guide routing decisions.

paragraphs.en: In this work, we study weak-to-strong routing in its general setting, jointly accounting for test-time sampling of candidate weak responses, candidate selection, and escalation to a stronger model. Conventional cascades and standard routing approaches rely on signals of response correctness, which are often costly to obtain and ambiguous to define in open-ended or agentic tasks. To bypass the need for ground-truth supervision, we introduce a perspective based on model disagreement. We derive corrected disagreement , a principled approximation to the optimal routing rule that balances cross-model disagreement against the strong model’s internal uncertainty. This formulation provides an objective learning signal that can be collected at scale from model-generated responses alone. Across multi-step agentic environments and reasoning benchmarks, our learned disagreement signal consistently outperforms label-free baselines, showing that our principled approximation offers a practical and scalable path to guiding hybrid inference without ground-truth supervision.
paragraphs.zh: 在这项工作中，我们研究了弱模型到强模型路由的一般性设置，同时考虑了测试时候选弱响应的采样、候选选择以及向更强模型升级的过程。 传统的级联结构和标准的路由方法依赖于响应正确性的信号，而这些信号在开放式或智能体任务中往往既难以获取，也难以明确定义。 为了绕过对真实标签监督的需求，我们提出了一种基于模型分歧的新视角。 我们推导出了修正后的分歧度，这是一种对最优路由规则的有原则的近似方法，能够在跨模型分歧与强模型内部不确定性之间取得平衡。 这种公式化方法提供了一个客观的学习信号，仅通过模型生成的响应即可大规模收集。 在多个步骤的智能体环境和推理基准测试中，我们学习到的分歧度信号始终优于无标签的基线方法，表明这种有原则的近似方法为在没有真实标签监督的情况下指导混合推理提供了一条实用且可扩展的路径。

paragraphs.en: As large language models are increasingly deployed, a broad literature has emerged around adaptive inference to balance response quality and computational cost. This design space generally splits into two paradigms: prompt-based routing, which selects a model before any text is generated [ 35 , 8 ] , and sequential cascades, which evaluate a cheaper model’s output before deciding whether to escalate [ 5 , 51 , 19 ] . While recent works such as [ 7 ] develop a unified formulation bridging both approaches, our work is specifically grounded in the cascade paradigm. Motivated by the growing need to deploy LLMs locally on resource-constrained edge devices [ 28 , 50 , 39 ] , we study a two-model cascade with a significant capability gap. In this setting, a weak local model first generates candidate responses, and the system subsequently decides whether to invoke a more capable, expensive strong model based entirely on the realized generation history. To contextualize our contributions, the remainder of this section categorizes prior work along three critical axes: when the routing decision occurs, the required test-time inference compute, and the reliance on ground-truth supervision.
paragraphs.zh: 随着大型语言模型部署日益广泛，围绕自适应推理以平衡响应质量与计算成本的研究成果也层出不穷。 这一设计空间通常分为两种范式：提示词路由（在生成任何文本前选择模型 [35, 8]）和级联序列（先评估较便宜模型的输出，再决定是否升级 [5, 51, 19]）。 尽管近期研究（如 [7]）提出了融合这两种方法的统一框架，但我们的工作则专门基于级联范式展开。 鉴于在资源受限的边缘设备上本地部署大型语言模型的需求日益增长 [28, 50, 39]，我们研究了一个存在显著能力差异的双模型级联系统。 在此设定中，一个较弱的本地模型首先生成候选响应，随后系统完全基于实际的生成历史，决定是否调用能力更强但成本更高的强模型。 为明确我们的贡献，本节余下部分将沿着三个关键维度对既有工作进行分类：路由决策发生的时间、推理阶段所需的计算资源，以及对真实标签监督的依赖程度。

paragraphs.en: Prompt-Based Routing and Learning to Defer . Prompt-based routers learn which model should answer an input without first observing its generated response. Building on classical literature regarding optimal deferral rules [ 33 , 19 ] , methods like Hybrid LLM [ 8 ] and Route LLM [ 35 ] allocate queries between models using learned predictions of quality. Other approaches focus on selecting a suitable expert from a larger pool of LLMs by predicting model performance through meta-models [ 2 ] , distilling reward assessments to identify expertise [ 29 ] , using input-dependent routing [ 44 ] , estimating translation improvements using prompt representations [ 31 ] , or decomposing input uncertainty using labeled calibration data to avoid routing inherently ambiguous queries [ 37 ] . These methods fundamentally differ from our approach in two ways: they make routing decisions before observing the generated weak response, and they heavily rely on ground-truth correctness or reward signals for training. In contrast, our cascade evaluates the realized weak response before routing, strictly in an unannotated two-model setting.
paragraphs.zh: 基于提示的路由与延迟决策学习。 基于提示的路由器无需先观察模型生成的响应，即可判断应由哪个模型回答输入问题。 在关于最优延迟决策规则的经典文献 [ 33 , 19 ] 的基础上，Hybrid LLM [ 8 ] 和 Route LLM [ 35 ] 等方法利用学习到的质量预测结果，在多个模型之间分配查询任务。 其他方法则专注于从更大的 LLM 集合中选择合适的专家，具体方式包括通过元模型预测模型性能 [ 2 ]、通过奖励评估蒸馏以识别专业领域 [ 29 ]、使用依赖输入的路由策略 [ 44 ]、利用提示表示估计翻译改进效果 [ 31 ]，或借助带标签的校准数据分解输入的不确定性，从而避免将本质上模棱两可的查询进行路由 [ 37 ]。 这些方法在两个方面与我们的方法存在根本差异：它们会在观察到生成的弱响应之前做出路由决策，并且训练过程严重依赖真实正确性标注或奖励信号。 相比之下，我们的级联系统在路由前会评估已实现的弱响应，且严格在无标注的双模型设置下运行。

sents.en: Other approaches focus on selecting a suitable expert from a larger pool of LLMs by predicting model performance through meta-models [ 2 ] , distilling reward assessments to identify expertise [ 29 ] , using input-dependent routing [ 44 ] , estimating translation improvements using prompt representations [ 31 ] , or decomposing input uncertainty using labeled calibration data to avoid routing inherently ambiguous queries [ 37 ] .
sents.zh: 其他方法则专注于从更大的 LLM 集合中选择合适的专家，具体方式包括通过元模型预测模型性能 [ 2 ]、通过奖励评估蒸馏以识别专业领域 [ 29 ]、使用依赖输入的路由策略 [ 44 ]、利用提示表示估计翻译改进效果 [ 31 ]，或借助带标签的校准数据分解输入的不确定性，从而避免将本质上模棱两可的查询进行路由 [ 37 ]。

sents.en: These methods fundamentally differ from our approach in two ways: they make routing decisions before observing the generated weak response, and they heavily rely on ground-truth correctness or reward signals for training.
sents.zh: 这些方法在两个方面与我们的方法存在根本差异：它们会在观察到生成的弱响应之前做出路由决策，并且训练过程严重依赖真实正确性标注或奖励信号。

sents.en: In contrast, our cascade evaluates the realized weak response before routing, strictly in an unannotated two-model setting.
sents.zh: 相比之下，我们的级联系统在路由前会评估已实现的弱响应，且严格在无标注的双模型设置下运行。

paragraphs.en: Supervised Confidence and Deferral ( N = 1 N=1 ). Cascade methods commonly assess whether a single generated weak response is reliable enough to retain. FrugalGPT [ 5 ] trains a response-quality scorer to escalate when its confidence is insufficient. [ 15 ] study token-level uncertainty and learned deferral predictors supervised directly by whether the strong model corrects a weak-model error. Automix [ 1 ] utilizes a POMDP routing policy trained on self-verification judgments and ground-truth signals. Finally, SELF-REF [ 6 ] and Gatekeeper [ 38 ] train the weak model to express verbalized confidence or produce more useful confidence scores. All of these methods rely on task-specific correctness labels for supervision, and cannot be deployed in our purely label-free setting. Motivated by these works, our supervised weak-correctness probe Proxy Reward serves as a controlled oracle reference to represent this category of quality-based deferral. Our proposed framework assumes no access to ground-truth correctness or improvement signals.
paragraphs.zh: 监督置信度与转交（N = 1 N=1）。 级联方法通常评估单个生成的弱响应是否足够可靠以保留。 FrugalGPT [5] 训练一个响应质量评分器，当置信度不足时进行升级。 [15] 研究了词元级别的不确定性，并学习了由强模型是否纠正弱模型错误直接监督的转交预测器。 Automix [1] 利用基于自我验证判断和真实信号训练的 POMDP 路由策略。 最后，SELF-REF [6] 和 Gatekeeper [38] 训练弱模型以表达语言化的置信度或生成更有用的置信度分数。 所有这些方法都依赖任务特定的正确性标签进行监督，无法部署在我们完全无标签的设置中。 受这些工作的启发，我们的监督弱正确性探针 Proxy Reward 作为一个受控的预言机参考，用于表示这类基于质量的转交机制。 我们提出的框架假设无法访问真实正确性或改进信号。

paragraphs.en: Consistency and Ensemble-Based Cascades ( N > 1 N>1 Label-Free). Consistency-based approaches assess reliability without labels by comparing multiple generated responses. [ 51 ] use self-consistency( [ 46 ] ) agreement among reasoning paths for deferral. Semantic Entropy [ 25 ] and Kernel Language Entropy [ 12 ] measure uncertainty over clusters of equivalent answers which can be used as deferral rules in cascades. Similarly, [ 53 ] rely on clustering to compute the semantic entropies of both student and teacher models to construct routing preferences. Other methods evaluate consensus across an ensemble of multiple models: ABC [ 23 ] uses pairwise similarities across inexpensive models, SMOOTHIE [ 14 ] estimates quality from distances between embedded outputs (which requires generator triplets), and [ 34 ] groups queries into skill clusters via confidence-weighted ensemble consensus. These within-model consistency methods (particularly self-consistency and semantic entropy) directly motivate our multi-sample ( N > 1 N>1 ) baselines. However, as a broader category, these approaches fundamentally differ from our framework in their operational assumptions and mechanics. First, ensemble routers ( [ 14 , 34 ] ) are designed to select among a diverse pool of multiple models, whereas we study a strict cascade between a single local weak model and a more capable strong model. Consequently, our framework only requires the weak model’s internal representations; the strong model can remain entirely black-box, accessed only for its text outputs during offline training. Second, consistency methods require generating multiple responses at inference time and rely heavily on semantic clustering. As we demonstrate in Section 6.2 , grouping responses into equivalence classes is notoriously brittle for open-ended tasks.

paragraphs.en: Learned Label-Free Reliability and Cross-Model Verification. Recent work has explored learning reliability predictors from unlabeled outputs or cross-model comparisons. Semantic Entropy Probes [ 24 ] predict semantic-entropy targets directly from model representations to enable single-response uncertainty estimation. HaloScope [ 10 ] derives pseudo-labels from unlabeled response representations to train a truthfulness classifier. Additionally, [ 47 ] , [ 16 ] , and [ 13 ] explore cross-model disagreement and verifier surprise to quantify uncertainty. These works provide strong conceptual motivation for comparing models and utilizing hidden-state probes. However, rather than detecting hallucinations or requiring test-time queries to a second model, our approach uniquely trains a probe on offline strong-model disagreement to directly approximate the optimal cascade routing gain, evaluating it autonomously at test time.
paragraphs.zh: 无标签可靠性学习与跨模型验证。 近期的研究探索了从无标签输出或跨模型比较中学习可靠性预测模型的方法。 语义熵探针 [ 24 ] 直接从模型表示中预测语义熵目标，从而实现单响应不确定性估计。 HaloScope [ 10 ] 从无标签的响应表示中推导出伪标签，以训练一个真实性分类器。 此外，[ 47 ]、[ 16 ] 和 [ 13 ] 探索了跨模型分歧与验证器意外性，以量化不确定性。 这些研究为模型比较和隐藏状态探针的应用提供了强有力的理论依据。 然而，我们的方法并非检测幻觉或要求在测试时向第二个模型发起查询，而是独特地通过离线训练强模型分歧的探针，直接近似最优级联路由增益，并在测试时自主完成评估。

paragraphs.en: Allocating Test-Time Computation. Additional inference computation can significantly improve response quality by generating and selecting among multiple candidates. For example, self-consistency [ 46 ] aggregates sampled reasoning paths, while broader test-time compute strategies [ 43 ] scale sampling and refinement based on input difficulty. For routing specifically, BEST-Route [ 9 ] pre-determines a sampling budget combined with model selection, and ModelSwitch [ 3 ] evaluates consistency across multi-model samples to adaptively halt generation. Our work studies when to escalate after observing the weak model’s candidate responses. We characterize the expected improvement from replacing the selected weak response with a strong-model response and develop a disagreement-based approximation to guide this decision without ground-truth correctness labels.
paragraphs.zh: 分配测试时的计算资源。 额外的推理计算可以通过生成并选择多个候选答案来显著提升响应质量。 例如，自一致性方法 [46] 会聚合采样出的推理路径，而更广泛的测试时计算策略 [43] 则会根据输入难度调整采样和精炼的规模。 具体在路由方面，BEST-Route [9] 会预先确定一个采样预算并结合模型选择，而 ModelSwitch [3] 则会评估多模型样本之间的一致性，以自适应地终止生成过程。 我们的工作研究的是在观察到弱模型的候选响应后，何时应当升级处理。 我们描述了用强模型响应替换所选的弱模型响应所能带来的预期改进，并开发了一种基于分歧的近似方法，用于在没有真实正确性标签的情况下指导这一决策。

paragraphs.en: Sequential Tasks and Step-Level Routing. In sequential tasks, escalation decisions must be made repeatedly as the agent’s state evolves. TRIM [ 20 ] uses process-level feedback to decide when to replace a weak reasoning step with a strong-model step. R2V-Agent [ 17 ] learns step-level escalation from weak-policy episode outcomes by combining uncertainty statistics with task-specific verifier features trained via verifier-guided DPO. Alternatively, Inference-Time Distillation [ 41 ] determines escalation based on consistency among candidate actions to guide a weak agent. These methods typically rely on explicit step-level correctness labels, task-specific process verifiers, or expensive test-time consistency checks (which we benchmark via our multi-sample baselines). Our agentic experiments (Section 6.1 ) show that by learning from objective action disagreement, we can outperform consistency based alternatives and effectively route at the step level without ever requiring episode-success labels or step-correctness annotations.
paragraphs.zh: 序列任务与步骤级路由。 在序列任务中，随着智能体的状态演变，必须反复做出升级决策。 TRIM [ 20 ] 利用过程级反馈来决定何时用强模型步骤替换较弱的推理步骤。 R2V-Agent [ 17 ] 通过结合不确定性统计量与经验证器引导 DPO 训练的任务特定验证器特征，从弱策略的回合结果中学习步骤级的升级决策。 另一种方法是推理时蒸馏 [ 41 ]，它基于候选动作之间的一致性来决定是否升级，以指导一个较弱的智能体。 这些方法通常依赖明确的步骤级正确性标签、任务特定的过程验证器，或成本高昂的测试时一致性检查（我们通过多样本基线对其进行了基准测试）。 我们的智能体实验（第 6.1 节）表明，通过从客观的动作分歧中学习，我们可以超越基于一致性的替代方法，并在步骤级进行有效路由，而无需任何回合成功标签或步骤正确性标注。

paragraphs.en: The results support the main observations: corrected disagreement generally improves on raw weak–strong disagreement and closely approximates optimal routing when the strong model is accurate. Its advantage over weak-model correctness is most apparent at limited routing budgets; the ordering can change at larger budgets. We first report the one-shot setting ( N = 1 N=1 ), then vary the number of weak-model samples N N . While correctness flags when the weak model is wrong, it cannot anticipate whether the strong model will actually succeed. In practice, weak-model correctness is often viewed as a highly accessible baseline because the strong model can act as an automated judge to provide those labels. Conversely, obtaining ground-truth labels for the strong model’s own correctness is notoriously difficult because it typically surpasses available automated judges. Our disagreement scores bypass this labeling bottleneck entirely while explicitly capturing potential accuracy gains. At very high escalation budgets, weak-model correctness slightly surpasses corrected disagreement because it strictly avoids routing those rare instances where the weak model is correct but the strong model fails. However, in typical weak-to-strong deployments, these failure modes are infrequent, making low-budget efficiency the governing practical metric.

paragraphs.en: To ensure our learned probes generalize to test-time deployments where strong-model interventions alter the trajectory state, we collect training data using an iterative, on-policy schedule inspired by DAgger [ 40 , 26 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 为确保我们训练出的探针能够泛化到测试时的部署场景——在这些场景中，强模型干预会改变轨迹状态——我们采用了一种受 DAgger [ 40 , 26 ] 启发的迭代、在线策略方案来收集训练数据。

paragraphs.en: During test-time routing, executing strong-model actions steers the agent into states that the weak model would not visit autonomously. Fitting probes exclusively on purely weak-model trajectories results in a distribution mismatch (the classic compounding-shift problem of behavioral cloning [ 40 ] .) We mitigate this by collecting training data across iterative phases: each phase rolls out the current routed policy, labels every visited state, and trains subsequent probes on the aggregated dataset from all preceding phases.
paragraphs.zh: 在测试时路由过程中，执行强模型的动作会将智能体引导至弱模型无法自主访问的状态。 如果仅基于纯弱模型轨迹来拟合探针，会导致分布不匹配（这是行为克隆中经典的累积偏移问题 [40]）。我们通过在各迭代阶段收集训练数据来缓解这一问题：每个阶段都会执行当前路由策略，为所有访问过的状态打上标签，并在所有先前阶段汇总的数据集上训练后续探针。
